description: Generate the 1-line HouseAdBanner integration snippet and SDK download URLs (or full single-file SDK source code) for Android Jetpack Compose, iOS SwiftUI, Flutter, React Native, or Hybrid WebView. Read-only; does not register the app or modify server state. Returns platform, packageName, oneLineSnippet, targetAudienceGuidance, zeroDependencySdkUrl, mirrorSdkUrl, selfPreviewTestPeriodDays, stepsForAiAgent, and (when includeFullSdkSource is true and platform is not web) sdkSourceCode. Usage: call first when adding Ad-o-matic to an app codebase; immediately call adomatic_onboard_app afterward to pre-register the app (even before Google Play or App Store publication), or adomatic_verify_integration to inspect an existing registration.

bannerText.description: Short benefit-driven banner tagline compiled into the app build (max 90 chars). Omit to generate a minimal snippet without inline copy.

includeFullSdkSource.description: When true, embeds the complete single-file SDK source code in sdkSourceCode (Android, iOS, Flutter, React Native only; omitted for web). Defaults to false.

packageName.description: Reverse-DNS Android applicationId or iOS bundleId embedded into the generated snippet. Defaults to "com.company.myapp" for preview when omitted.

platform.description: Target mobile framework SDK. Defaults to "android" when omitted.

targetAudience.description: Free-form natural-language customer group (2-6 personas, hobbies, or domain keywords plus optional age band 18-24, 25-44, or 45+). Omit if unknown to fall back to automatic metadata inference.

name: adomatic_get_integration
